nodes.title: Note: About Points Editor
widgets_values:
## How to load image 

You can right-click on the canvas, then choose Load Image. Or you can run the workflow once, and it will automatically get the first frame of the input video.

## Add new green points

Green points are used to mark the area that you want to detect.
Press the Shift key, then use the left click to add new green points.

## Add new red points

Red points are used to mark the area you want to exclude.
Press the Shift key, then use the right click to add new red points.

## Clear all points

Click the **New canvas** to clear all points

nodes.title: Note: Animation Modes
widgets_values:
## Mode 1: Pose Transfer

If you want to make the character in Reference Image adapt the actions of the character in Reference Video, ensure that `bg_images` and `mask` inputs in `WanVideo Animate Embeds` are **unlinked**.

## Mode 2: Replace Character

If you want to replace the character in Reference Video with the character in Reference Image, link `Get_bkg_video` to `bg_images` and `Get_char_mask` to `mask` in `WanVideo Animate Embeds`.
